From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@acme-analytics.com>, Acme Procurement <procure@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Runway health check: account vignettes + OKR gating

Team —

As we lock Q4 prep, I want a compact runbook for the Acme Analytics account for the QBR on 2026-12-15. Primary asks:

- 1-page account vignette (status, blockers, ARR motion, next 30/90 days)
- Consolidated forecast for Dec/Jan (best / likely / upside) with any contingent conversion triggers
- Callouts against Sales OKRs (pipeline coverage, NGA + expansions) that might affect the leadership readout

Marcus: can you ingest the latest CS notes and produce the vignette pdf by EOD 2026-12-03? Attach any supporting slides.
Mina: please run a sensitivity on our forecast scenarios (include tradeoffs for retaining Reserved capacity vs. Hosted migration) — deliver as csv.
Aditya: I need a crisp bullet list of top two escalation risks and the mitigation ask (credits, legal acceleration, or tech support) — plan to present to leadership on 12/09.

Jordan & Acme team — looping you so we can align expectations ahead of the QBR. If there are new procurement timelines, please flag now.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0192

Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 15:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runway health check: account vignettes + OKR gating

Kimberly —

Attached is a draft: 20261203-acme-account-vignettes.pdf. Highlights below (TL;DR):

- Current ARR: $1.2M ARR committed (Dedicated) + $150k in Hosted pilot usage.
- Main blocker: procurement wants a clause around data residency and a 3-month SLA credit for the Dedicated pilot.
- Near-term conversion triggers: successful three-week latency benchmark and SOC2 evidence delivered by 12/07.
- Expansion motion: Product team flagged a potential ML inferencing use-case that could add $300–500k ARR if we get a POC signed in Q1.

I pulled attachable slides (page 3 shows latency metrics) — I referenced the CS notes and the latest test harness results.

Next steps I propose:
- Deliver vignette to Kimberly for leadership polish by 12/04 AM.
- Ask Product to scope POC costs (cc’d internally separately).

Marcus Lin
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachments: 20261203-acme-account-vignettes.pdf (account vignette, 3 slides)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runway health check: account vignettes + OKR gating

Team —

Attached is the forecast rollup: 20261205-forecast-rollup.csv. Summary here (Best / Likely / Upside):

- Dec: $175k / $120k / $275k (Committed + close-prob weighted)
- Jan: $300k / $210k / $420k (includes Acme conversion in upside)
- Total Q1 carry-in expected: $450k likely, $695k upside.

Sensitivity notes (from Mina): converting Acme in Dec requires two items: SOC2 evidence + a signed data residency addendum. If procurement wants SLA credits we can offer a 20% onboarding credit applied to first invoice; legal prefers to keep credits capped and term-limited.

Top two escalation risks:
1) Procurement timing (if Acme shifts to Jan, our Dec forecast drops ~24%); mitigation: propose a firm DocuSign deadline (12/09) and offer a targeted onboarding credit.
2) Latency benchmark miss on Dedicated pilot; mitigation: auto-failover to Hosted with cost-offset proposal (technical workaround in place, product to confirm).

I recommend we present both the conservative and upside numbers, and mark Acme as a conditional conversion for Dec.

-Aditya

Attachments: 20261205-forecast-rollup.csv (best/likely/upside scenarios)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@acme-analytics.com>, Acme Procurement <procure@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runway health check: account vignettes + OKR gating

Thanks team — solid work. Short summary for leadership deck and immediate asks: 

- Acme is conditional for Dec: Likely $120k; upside $275k if DocuSign in by EOD 12/09 and SOC2 bundle delivered by 12/07 (we have evidence in the Drive link).
- Action: Marcus to confirm with Jordan that procurement will sign by 12/09 noon PT and confirm which SLA credit they want (onboarding credit or term credit).
- Action: Mina to publish the scenario csv to the shared Drive and tag the impacted OKR lines (pipeline coverage + closed-won rate).
- Leadership ask: recommend pre-approval to offer a one-time 20% onboarding credit (max $30k) if Acme signs this week to protect our Dec runway. If Legal needs to redline, we escalate to exec legal approval — notify me by 12/10 10:00 AM.

I'll fold these bullets into the readout slide and include the attachment pointers. If we get a signed DocuSign before EOD, Marcus — ping me and I'll mark the account in the forecast as "closed" for the QBR pack.

Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
